BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Hunter, Sullivan, Carlyle, and S. Hunt
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Directing the treasurer to transfer into the general fund in the 2017-2019 fiscal biennium the entire budget stabilization account deposit attributable to extraordinary revenue growth.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to directing the treasurer to transfer into the general fund in the 2017-2019 fiscal biennium the entire budget stabilization account deposit attributable to extraordinary revenue growth; and creating a new section.

BillSectionHeader.P: During the 2017-2019 fiscal biennium, the treasurer shall transfer into the state general fund the entire budget stabilization account deposit that is attributable to extraordinary revenue growth.
